targets.//: outputs covers dist/ only, even though this target also syncs engine.js into the Xcode wrapper's 'Shared (App)/Resources/' (scripts/sync-engine.mts). Same reason apps/safari-host-app/project.json leaves its sync undeclared, and it is a hard limitation rather than a choice: Nx's native glob reads the literal parens in 'Shared (App)' as group syntax and matches nothing, and neither backslash escapes nor [(] character classes fix it. dist/engine.js is therefore what a cache hit must restore, since the sync copies from there. NOTE: unlike the host app, no Safari build path invokes this target yet — apps/extension/scripts/build-safari-app.mts and scripts/prepare-safari-build.sh still build only @movar/safari-host-app, and project.pbxproj has no engine.js reference. Until both are wired the bundle reaches Resources but not the shipped app.
